title: Asahina Mafuyu — Tasting Some Serious Squid〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - School Festival

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We've gone around most of the school now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, what do we have left? The stalls outside?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. We saw that cotton candy stall at the end and the ones near the rest area...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we still haven't been to your class's stall, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The lunch rush is probably over, so it may not be all that crowded.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're serious about going...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, since we're here!
You practiced making them a ton, right? You gotta grill us up some squid!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, fine. If it isn't that crowded...
Stalls

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really...?
There's no one here.

rows.Speaker: Ena's Classmate
rows.Line: Hi, Shinonome! Oh, you brought friends...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, they wanted to try our squid.
Oh, these look just about ready, so could we have them...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wait, Ena, aren't you going to grill us some?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? It doesn't matter who makes them. They basically all turn out the same...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, but we wanna have ones that you grilled.

rows.Speaker: Ena's Classmate
rows.Line:
Hehe. The grill's all yours, Shinonome.
These ones are actually part of an order, and I was just about to go deliver them.

rows.Speaker: Ena's Classmate
rows.Line: So, show your friends just how much you've been practicing for this!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: O-Okay. Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Ena's Classmate
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'm gonna go deliver these!
Have fun, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, Ena, show us what you got!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, fine. I just need to make two, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, all I'll really be doing is throwing them on the grill since they're already seasoned...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, they're starting to sizzle nicely.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, they are...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Can't somebody talk about something...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because this feels really awkward.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha... Alright, then...
What gave you trouble when you were learning how to grill squid?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How the smell clings to your clothes.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wore my uniform while practicing on the grill, and it kept smelling no matter how much deodorizing spray I used on it afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is that all...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No way, she's surely got more to say.
Like the trick to grilling them just enough for optimum flavor, or...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, all I have to do is throw them on the grill! Can't you show a little more interest in what I had to say?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I dunno what to tell you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, where were the squids you're grilling caught? Also, what species are they?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? So, we made sure to find two suppliers in case anything happened with one of them...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Which one are these from...?
I remember one of the suppliers was in Hokkaido...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You could've picked an easier topic, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... What should we talk about now...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Come to think of it, squid is apparently “grilled” very differently depending on if you're in the Kanto or Kansai region.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, one of my classmates mentioned that.
We're all used to seeing squid grilled whole as it is over here in Kanto.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that came up in one of the anime I saw! In Kansai...
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, they're done!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Awesome!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The topics you came up with made the time fly right by, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Oh, I don't wanna burn my tongue, so you two start without me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Here you are, Kanade, Mafuyu.
They're really hot, so please be careful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Let's eat...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How are they?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's softer and easier to bite through than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's good.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right? We did get some good squid for this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you couldn't remember where these were caught or what species they are...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just eat.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha!
